topic: Required range resolution / 250 kHz LFM suitability
answer: Provisionally accept theoretical range resolution 600 m at LFM bandwidth 250 kHz for phase-one proof of function; measurable acceptance criteria deferred to S02.

topic: Receive window and candidate target ranges
answer: 128 complex IQ samples at 1 MS/s, nominal 19.2 km window; valid detection region to be determined after time origin and matched filter edge analysis. 3,6,9 km targets suggested for initial testing; boundary cases separate.
Sample n=0 represents start of LFM transmit pulse, with echo round-trip delays relative to this origin. Reference model must define matched filter timing and processing-delay compensation precisely.
